moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: Has a chance (30%) of making the target flinch.

moves.name: Dire Hit All +
moves.description: Raises the critical-hit rate of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user begins flying. After a set time, the user stops flying and attacks. No other actions can be taken while flying. Most moves used by opponents will not hit the user while it is flying. If the user is hit by a sync move or max move while flying, it will stop flying.

moves.name: Soar!
moves.description: Raises the Attack and Sp. Atk of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks. Raises the user’s Speed by 1 stat rank.
